preconditions.description: The number of passwords n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of failed tries k is between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of passwords provided matches n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(password) <= 100 for password in passwords)
preconditions.description: Each password length is between 1 and 100 characters inclusive.
Each password consists only of latin letters and digits.
The Codehorses password is one of the provided passwords.

postconditions.description: The best case time is at least 1 second.
The worst case time is at least as long as the best case time.
The best case time is the position of the Codehorses password in the sorted list of passwords plus one second.

postconditions.expression: worst_time == sum(1 + (i // k) * 5 for i in range(passwords.index(codehorses_password))) + 1
postconditions.description: The worst case time is calculated by summing the time taken for each wrong password attempt including the 5-second delay after every k wrong attempts, plus one second for the correct password.
